events.title: Chicken & Biscuits
events.blurb: The Youngstown Playhouse closes its run of Douglas Lyons' comedy about two sisters reunited for their father's funeral. Some seats are pay-what-you-can.
events.blurbEs: La Youngstown Playhouse cierra la temporada de esta comedia de Douglas Lyons sobre dos hermanas que se reencuentran en el funeral de su padre. Algunos asientos son de pago voluntario.
events.getThere: Saturday's show moved to 8 p.m. because of the downtown Holiday Parade; arrive no earlier than 7:30 p.m. and approach from the west, as the Market Street bridge will be closed.

events.title: TubaChristmas & Holiday Craft Show
events.blurb: Local tuba players fill the hall with Christmas classics at 4 p.m., with a craft show of local makers in the ballroom from 11 a.m. Parking is free.
events.blurbEs: Tubistas locales interpretan clásicos navideños a las 4 p.m., con una feria de artesanos locales en el salón de baile desde las 11 a.m. El estacionamiento es gratis.

events.title: Memories of Christmas Past
events.blurb: The Mahoning Valley Historical Society's 18th annual holiday exhibit fills the Arms mansion with vintage decorations and toys. Admission includes same-day entry to the Tyler History Center.
events.blurbEs: La 18.ª exhibición navideña anual de la Mahoning Valley Historical Society llena la mansión Arms de adornos y juguetes antiguos. La entrada incluye acceso el mismo día al Tyler History Center.

events.title: Butler Institute of American Art
events.blurb: The first museum devoted to American art, always free, with a free lot next door.
events.blurbEs: El primer museo dedicado al arte estadounidense, siempre gratis, con estacionamiento gratuito al lado.
events.getThere: Free first-come lot directly adjacent to the museum.

events.title: Mill Creek Park
events.blurb: Gorges, waterfalls and a covered bridge in a 4,400-acre park.
events.blurbEs: Desfiladeros, cascadas y un puente cubierto en un parque de 1.800 hectáreas.

events.title: Youngstown State vs. Bryant & Stratton
events.blurb: Penguins men's basketball on Friday afternoon at the Zidian Family Arena.
events.blurbEs: Baloncesto masculino de los Penguins el viernes por la tarde en el Zidian Family Arena.
